name: Jemgum (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Jemgum (a yellow windmill between stars above a wavy bar on green).
history: Municipal flag of Jemgum; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Jemgum arms — windmill, stars and wavy bar on green
